prior_summary: Contact belief rather than command state. A learned two-observation recurrent contact filter, soft mode transitions, and a persistent probabilistic gripper decoder condition a joint eight-channel action diffusion model. Masked finger-response and TCP-relative object-transform forecasting provide additional trainable contact/co-motion supervision. The complete expanded acquisition slices include predecessor red descent, opening, retreat, blue approach, closure, lift and initial transport.
applicable_conditions: State-based Panda manipulation at 20 Hz with qpos/qvel, world TCP and both block poses, wxyz quaternions and both goals. Prefer two consecutive causal observations and the demonstrated red-first/blue-second context. Observed entry may be empty/open, closing, loaded, or opening over the predecessor pad. This executable interface has no role IDs or executed-command history, so those parts of the source hypothesis are weakened to learned inference from both colored objects, goals, finger motion and local co-motion. Use the shared full-demonstration normalizer without refitting.
termination_guidance: For acquisition-to-delivery transfer, seek observed requested-object lift toward the demonstrated z near 0.28 m with a small, consistent TCP-object transform and continuing grasp-maintaining motion toward its own goal. Narrow fingers or a close command alone are insufficient. Continue through predecessor lowering/release/retreat when that transition is unfinished. Earlier transfer inside pickup overlap is possible only if the successor continues verification and lift. These are handoff cues, not extra conditions on the supplied red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal task success predicate.
limitations: Two observations do not implement long-lived command-conditioned memory; no external requested/predecessor ID can enter forward. Binary gripper probabilities condition the fixed eight-channel DDPM rather than overriding its continuous gripper output. Mode labels are weak geometry/motion/command-derived targets, not contact measurements; no missed-grasp or slip recovery is validated. No IK, force sensing, image encoder, hard kinematic constraint or joint-action equivariance is implemented. No performance feedback is available; checks establish implementation validity only.

config.segmentation: Unchanged assignment: all 24 expanded slices, with no phase filtering or boundary cuts
config.gripper_decoder: 96-wide GRU with learned initial open probability and two learned transition hazards; probabilities and hazards embed into diffusion conditioning
config.diffused_action: All eight shared-normalized channels: seven absolute Panda joint targets and continuous dimensionless gripper command
config.action_alignment: Slots t-1 through t+14; future observation in each slot is the state after that action
config.physics_decoder: 128-wide action-conditioned GRU predicting current-relative deltas of two finger positions, two TCP-relative poses, and two object heights
config.normalization: Shared original full-demonstration ranges; derived positions use the maximum of the shared TCP/red/blue coordinate half-ranges; quaternion components retain unit scale
config.future_target_masking: Both action and future masks, excluding slot zero; adjacent valid pairs for command transition labels
config.deployment_extra_inputs: None; no role IDs, previous commands, persistent cache or future observations
